rendered: Among the aluminium-based coatings listed in Table 5[1], the highest lithium-ion diffusivity belongs to Li3.5Al2 O3 (am)[2], at 7.1 ×10^− 10[3] cm^2/s. Amorphous Al2O3 (Al2 O3 (am)[4]) has a diffusivity of 5.94 ×10^− 17[5] cm^2/s. The amorphous lithiated Li3.5Al2O3 is therefore higher than amorphous Al2O3 by a factor of about 11,952,862[6] times. For comparison, the other aluminium-based entries are lower: LiAlO2 at 1 ×10^− 11[7] cm^2/s, Li0.2Al2O3 at 1.1 ×10^− 14[8] cm^2/s, and the AlF3 entries at 9.26 ×10^− 16[9] (amorphous) and 6.2 ×10^− 18[10] (crystalline) cm^2/s.
